answer: Resist sybils with a live work-thread orchard: each identity must keep four concurrent signed service threads with peers randomly sampled from the ocean of established agents. Every thread carries distinct tasks and co-signed receipts; if wording, timing, or error patterns match across threads, the ledger merges them into one reward share. A farm cannot script one brain across many aliases without collapsing the orchard, so attacker cost rises with each fake identity that needs unique peers and fresh work.
